from jinja2 import Environment

def handle(query, state):
    secret = state['secret']
    # A naive "report previewer" that lets users supply a custom report
    # title template string via ?title=... The title is spliced directly
    # into a Jinja2 template and rendered by the real engine with no
    # sandbox, so any Jinja2 expression inside title is evaluated.
    # The flag is bound in the render context as `token`, so
    # {{token}} leaks it.  Correct arithmetic works too (control probe).
    #
    # Wrong technique: Mako/Cheetah-style ${...} is not Jinja2 syntax
    # and is echoed back verbatim — it never executes.

    title = (query.get('title') or ['Monthly Report'])[0]

    env = Environment()
    template_src = "<report><title>" + title + "</title><body>Your report is ready.</body></report>"
    try:
        tmpl = env.from_string(template_src)
        rendered = tmpl.render(token=secret)
    except Exception as e:
        rendered = '[template error: {}]'.format(e)

    return 200, {'Content-Type': 'text/xml'}, rendered
